name: Nippon Fine Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Fine Chemical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells fine chemical, cosmetic, and industrial chemical products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Functional Products and Environmental Hygiene Products segments. The company offers cosmetic ingredients such as skin care, makeup, hair care and personal care products; natural oils and fats for pharmaceutical, cosmetic, industrial, and feed additive applications; and phospholipids used in pharmaceutical raw materials, presome, cholesterol, liposome, and other lipids.
